title: Lock 1 Distilling Company
about: Lock 1 Distilling Company is a family farm distillery in Phoenix, the Oswego County village where the Oswego Canal begins its run north from the Erie Canal toward Lake Ontario. Cousins Brenden Backus, Stephen Dates and Kevin Dates opened it in 2015 across from the canal’s Lock 1, and built most of their equipment themselves in Backus’s fabrication shop.
Eden pours five of their spirits. Find them on the spirits list in our menu.
